title: Blue Giant
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Dai Miyamoto, a high school student in Sendai with no clear goal, falls for jazz, gets a saxophone bought on loan by his older brother, and practices alone by the river. After harsh early criticism and lessons from a teacher, he moves to Tokyo after graduation, vowing to become the greatest jazz player in the world, and forms a trio. Sequels follow him to Europe and America.
life_message: Wholehearted love of your craft, stubborn practice and honest feeling can carry you toward greatness.
